claims.text: Montelukast for allergic rhinitis: once daily (seasonal from 2 years, perennial from 6 months);
claims.quote: Seasonal allergic rhinitis: Once daily for patients 2 years and older ( 2.3 ). Perennial allergic rhinitis: Once daily for patients 6 months and older ( 2.3 ).

claims.text: Reserve for an inadequate response to or intolerance of other therapies (neuropsychiatric risk).
claims.quote: Because the benefits of SINGULAIR may not outweigh the potential risk of neuropsychiatric symptoms in patients with allergic rhinitis, reserve use for patients who have an inadequate response or intolerance to alternative therapies

claims.text: Montelukast: watch for behavior/mood changes; stop and call the prescriber if new neuropsychiatric symptoms or suicidal thoughts occur.
claims.quote: Advise patients and/or caregivers to be alert for changes in behavior or new NP symptoms when taking SINGULAIR. If changes in behavior are observed, or if new NP symptoms or suicidal thoughts and/or behavior occur, advise patients to discontinue SINGULAIR and contact a healthcare provider immediately
All patients should have available for rescue a short-acting β-agonist.
